scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: npm run icons:check && wxt build --browser chrome
scripts.build:firefox: npm run icons:check && wxt build --browser firefox
scripts.zip: npm run zip:chrome && npm run zip:firefox
scripts.zip:chrome: npm run icons:check && wxt zip --browser chrome
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run icons:check && wxt zip --browser firefox
